parts.name: VoiceRing
parts.description: A ring of light for a voice interface: three loops and a halo that open and wobble as the voice gets louder. It is drawn in CSS from the theme's glow hues, so it needs no canvas and follows the palette and color mode. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it holds still.

props.name: state
props.description: Where the conversation is. `listening` and `speaking` follow `level`. `idle` is dim and slow. `processing` closes the loops into circles that chase their own tails.

props.name: level
props.description: The voice level from 0 to 1: a microphone's while listening, the reply's while speaking. `createMicrophoneLevel` in `internal/voice.js` gives a microphone's.

props.name: tone
props.description: `spectrum` blends `--glow-1`, `--glow-2` and `--glow-3`. `mono` draws in the element's text color.

props.name: size
props.description: 1.5rem, 3rem or 6rem at the default spacing. For another size, set `--ring-size`.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the ring for assistive technology and gives it `role="img"`. Without it the ring is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the element. A Tailwind size such as `size-24` or a text color such as `text-primary` overrides the defaults.

cssVariables.name: --voice-level
cssVariables.description: The level the ring follows, set from the `level` prop.

cssVariables.name: --ring-size
cssVariables.description: The width and height of the ring.

cssVariables.name: --ring-a, --ring-b, --ring-c
cssVariables.description: The three colors of the ring. They default to the theme's glow hues.
